observations.why: The segment frames a test case AS a reproduction of a prod failure pattern — structured A-is-to-B reasoning where the local case stands in for the prod case.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Two matched clauses with identical modal-verb opening ('must not' / 'must produce') set in deliberate parallel — a matched grammatical structure across clauses.
Framing a known failure pattern as something to reproduce appeals to stability and keeping what is known — conservation of an established reference point.
The modal 'must' paired with 'valid' frames output correctness as a capability requirement — competence as the appealed-to good.
